data.title: Unit 10: Force and machines
Force
data.heading: Balanced and unbalanced forces
data.text: Buoyancy is an upward pressure exerted by water which keeps things afloat.
Gravity is the force that pulls everything to the centre of the Earth.
Friction is the force that slows down or stops moving objects.
Air resistance is a type of friction which slows down things moving through air.
Normal force is the force that operates when two still objects are in contact with each other.
